The notify callback on your HIU bridge carries consentArtefacts with the artefact ids. Fetch the artefact with /api/hiecm/consent/v3/fetch and then request the health information.
there were two ids in it, do i need both

must_contain: A consent request produces one artefact per HIP, so a request that spans facilities returns several.
Store and fetch every artefact id the notification listed, not only the first.
Taking only the first artefact silently drops records, and nothing reports an error.
